versions.changelog: fix(l3): enable follow-up conversation for isolated scheduled news. When news is delivered via isolated scheduled tasks, users couldn't ask follow-up questions — the new conversation has no context about what was previously sent.
Add preference handling, survey/feedback delivery, workflow rendering, scheduled task guidance, and L2/L3 compatibility updates.
feat(l3): apply server-provided reply guidance to improve news prioritization and visibility of upgrade and sponsor messages
feat: improve L3 daily AI news output so users can see the most important stories first and get a more complete view of key updates from news, GitHub, social media, video, and other sources

Problem Solved：
  - All times previously displayed in UTC or Asia/Shanghai timezone
  - Confusing for users in other timezones

  ---
  🎯 Key Improvements

  1. Auto Timezone Detection
    - Automatically detects your local timezone
    - Manual override via AINEWS_CLIENT_TIMEZONE environment variable
    - Supports IANA timezone format (e.g., America/New_York, Europe/London)
  2. User-Friendly Time Display
    - Prioritizes your local timezone for display
    - New display_notice field shows natural language update time
    - Example: "This is the latest available AI news, updated at 2026-05-17 08:41:02 EDT."
  3. Local Date Support for get_news_dataset
    - Input dates are interpreted in your local timezone
    - Response explains local date to canonical date mapping

  ---
  🔧 Backward Compatible

  - No breaking changes for existing users
  - All legacy APIs continue to work
Fix OpenClaw installation instructions in README; update SKILL.md version
Restructure repository for Hermes tap compatibility and republish from the skills/ai-daily-news path.
MIT-0 relicensing, metadata cleanup, and v1.0.2 release prep.
